What the panel does with these keys Jira and Confluence not checked Enabled Where requirements come from and where defects and reports go. One key for both systems when they share a site. Site URL The connector cannot be enabled without this field Email Cloud only: the key works there in a pair with the email. Leave empty for Server/DC. Deployment Not set Cloud Server / Data Center Unset — detected by a live check and remembered. Confluence URL Fill in when Confluence does not live on the Jira host. Connect Atlassian MCP The same site and the same key, but available to the agent inside a conversation. The server is added to the MCP section — it can be removed from there too. Token No key yet. It goes into the encrypted store and never returns to this screen. Cloud: an API token from •••••••••••• together with the email below. Server/DC: a personal access token, leave the email empty. Save Check connection Not filled in: Site URL Forge by token not checked Enabled GitHub or GitLab directly, without gh and glab installed: needed where the CLI cannot be installed. System Not set GitHub GitLab What is on the other end: GitHub or GitLab. Installation URL Own GitLab — the installation URL. Empty = •••••••••••• or ••••••••••••. Repository owner/repo or a numeric project id. Empty — derived from the checked project origin. Token No key yet. It goes into the encrypted store and never returns to this screen. GitHub: a personal access token with issue rights. GitLab: a project or personal token with the api scope. Save Check connection Not filled in: System Telegram not checked Enabled Where the panel writes about finished runs, agent questions and permission requests. Chat The connector cannot be enabled without this field What to write about Run finished Run failed Case failed Agent asks for rights Agent asked a question Contour budget running out Send a test message Token No key yet. It goes into the encrypted store and never returns to this screen. A bot token from @BotFather. The bot must be added to the chat, otherwise it cannot post there. Save Check connection Not filled in: Chat Webhook not checked Enabled The same events at an address of your own: Slack, Mattermost, an on-call bot, an internal bus — one POST with JSON. Receiver URL The connector cannot be enabled without this field What to write about Run finished Run failed Case failed Agent asks for rights Agent asked a question Contour budget running out Send a test event Only the event header leaves the machine: kind, text and the project folder name. No prompt, no agent answer, no paths. Token No key yet. It goes into the encrypted store and never returns to this screen. A signing secret, not an access token. Set — the body is signed with the X-AgentDeck-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256, hex). Empty — sent unsigned. Save Check connection Not filled in: Receiver URL Test management not checked Enabled Zephyr, Xray or Test IT: pull cases into a panel group and push run results back. A repeated push lands in the same run. System Not set Zephyr Scale Xray Test IT Zephyr Scale, Xray or Test IT — the case format follows from it. Installation URL Test IT only: the URL of your own installation. Zephyr and Xray share one API. Project The connector cannot be enabled without this field Test group Which panel group to sync with. Empty — the panel asks at exchange time. Token No key yet. It goes into the encrypted store and never returns to this screen. Zephyr Scale: its own API key. Xray: key and secret in one line separated by a colon. Test IT: the personal token from the profile. Empty — the Atlassian key is used. Save Check connection Not filled in: System, Project CI reports not checked Enabled Where to pull the latest build report from, so no file has to be uploaded by hand. System Not set GitHub Actions GitLab CI GitHub Actions or GitLab CI. Repository owner/repo or a project id. Empty — derived from origin. Workflow Workflow or job name. Empty — the last finished run. Artifact Artifact name or the path to the report inside it. Token No key yet. It goes into the encrypted store and never returns to this screen. The same forge token, but allowed to read build artifacts. Save Check connection Not filled in: System
